leanings.detail: Every viewpoint carries a synthesized lean + confidence, visible in nd brief and nd show. Overall thesis (N-0001, mixed/medium) fully recoverable verbatim: China's pop decline+aging does NOT inevitably cause Japan-style lost decades, but potential growth steps structurally down; decisive difference is development stage (Japan 1991 ~85% US per-capita after catch-up exhausted vs China <30% with convergence room); offsets partly cushion but are mostly 'potential' contingent on a policy pivot toward consumption/market reform; controlled-Japanification is most likely, real downside tail (no pivot -> debt-deflation stasis). Child leans explicit: N-0002 supports/high, N-0003/4/5/6/7 all mixed/medium. Root synthesis also lists 5 open_questions and confidence=medium.
